dedupe_keys.name: lanka metro transit gtfs schedule and real time transit data

description: Lanka Metro Transit: GTFS schedule and real-time transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by Lanka Metro Transit. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Colombo District, Western Province, Sri Lanka, with real-time vehicle, trip or alert feeds. Coverage: Colombo District, Western Province, Sri Lanka. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed and 3 GTFS Realtime feeds for this provider (Colombo District, Western Province, Sri Lanka). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Shapes, Stops Wheelchair Accessibility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
